- [ ] **Step 1: Create `styles.go`**

```go
package memorylooptui

import (
	"os"

	"github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss"
	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/termstyle"
)

type tuiStyles struct {
	colorEnabled bool

	// Status colors
	active     lipgloss.Style
	candidate  lipgloss.Style
	suppressed lipgloss.Style
	archived   lipgloss.Style

	// Kind colors
	repoRule         lipgloss.Style
	workflowRule     lipgloss.Style
	agentInstruction lipgloss.Style
	skillPatch       lipgloss.Style
	antiPattern      lipgloss.Style

	// UI elements
	title       lipgloss.Style
	selected    lipgloss.Style
	dim         lipgloss.Style
	bold        lipgloss.Style
	tabActive   lipgloss.Style
	tabInactive lipgloss.Style
	statusBar   lipgloss.Style
	errorFlash  lipgloss.Style
}

func newStyles() tuiStyles {
	useColor := termstyle.ShouldUseColor(os.Stdout)

	s := tuiStyles{colorEnabled: useColor}

	if !useColor {
		return s
	}

	green := lipgloss.Color("2")
	red := lipgloss.Color("1")
	yellow := lipgloss.Color("3")
	cyan := lipgloss.Color("6")
	gray := lipgloss.Color("8")
	amber := lipgloss.Color("214")
	purple := lipgloss.Color("5")

	s.active = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(green)
	s.candidate = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(yellow)
	s.suppressed = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(red)
	s.archived = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(gray)

	s.repoRule = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(green)
	s.workflowRule = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(green)
	s.agentInstruction = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(amber)
	s.skillPatch = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(purple)
	s.antiPattern = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(red)

	s.title = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(cyan)
	s.selected = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(cyan)
	s.dim = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true)
	s.bold = lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true)
	s.tabActive = lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true).Foreground(cyan)
	s.tabInactive = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(gray)
	s.statusBar = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true)
	s.errorFlash = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(red)

	return s
}

func (s tuiStyles) render(style lipgloss.Style, text string) string {
	if !s.colorEnabled {
		return text
	}
	return style.Render(text)
}
```

   338→func renderTabBar(s tuiStyles, activeTab int, width int, mode memoryloop.Mode, policy memoryloop.ActivationPolicy) string {
   339→	var b strings.Builder
   340→
   341→	for i, name := range tabNames {
   342→		label := fmt.Sprintf("%d %s", i+1, name)
   343→		if i == activeTab {
   344→			b.WriteString(s.render(s.tabActive, label))
   345→		} else {

   348→		if i < len(tabNames)-1 {

   350→		}
   351→	}
   352→
   353→	// Right-align mode and policy indicators

   355→	modeStr := s.render(s.active, fmt.Sprintf("● %s", mode))
   356→	policyStr := s.render(s.dim, fmt.Sprintf("· %s", policy))
   357→	right := modeStr + " " + policyStr
   358→
   359→	// Pad between left and right
   360→	leftLen := lipglossWidth(left)
   361→	rightLen := lipglossWidth(right)
   362→	padding := width - leftLen - rightLen
   363→	if padding < 1 {

   365→	}
   366→

   427→	switch {

   439→// lipglossWidth estimates visible width by stripping ANSI sequences.
   440→// For simple use; not a full ANSI parser.
   441→func lipglossWidth(s string) int {
   442→	inEscape := false
   443→	w := 0
   444→	for _, r := range s {
   445→		if r == '\x1b' {
   446→			inEscape = true
   447→			continue
   448→		}
   449→		if inEscape {
   450→			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') {
   451→				inEscape = false
   452→			}
   453→			continue
   454→		}
   455→		w++
   456→	}
   457→	return w
   458→}

	repoRule         lipgloss.Style
	workflowRule     lipgloss.Style
	agentInstruction lipgloss.Style
	skillPatch       lipgloss.Style
	antiPattern      lipgloss.Style

	// UI elements
	title       lipgloss.Style
	selected    lipgloss.Style
	dim         lipgloss.Style
	bold        lipgloss.Style
	tabActive   lipgloss.Style
	tabInactive lipgloss.Style
	statusBar   lipgloss.Style
	errorFlash  lipgloss.Style
}

func newStyles() tuiStyles {
	useColor := termstyle.ShouldUseColor(os.Stdout)

	s := tuiStyles{colorEnabled: useColor}

	if !useColor {
		return s
	}

	green := lipgloss.Color("2")
	red := lipgloss.Color("1")
	yellow := lipgloss.Color("3")
	cyan := lipgloss.Color("6")
	gray := lipgloss.Color("8")
	amber := lipgloss.Color("214")
	purple := lipgloss.Color("5")

	s.active = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(green)
	s.candidate = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(yellow)
	s.suppressed = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(red)
	s.archived = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(gray)

	s.repoRule = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(green)
	s.workflowRule = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(green)
	s.agentInstruction = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(amber)
	s.skillPatch = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(purple)
	s.antiPattern = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(red)

	s.title = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(cyan)
	s.selected = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(cyan)
	s.dim = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true)
	s.bold = lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true)
	s.tabActive = lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true).Foreground(cyan)
	s.tabInactive = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(gray)
	s.statusBar = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true)
	s.errorFlash = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(red)

	return s
}

func (s tuiStyles) render(style lipgloss.Style, text string) string {
	if !s.colorEnabled {
		return text
	}
	return style.Render(text)
}

package memorylooptui

import "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles/key"

type globalKeys struct {
	TabNext key.Binding
	TabPrev key.Binding
	Tab1    key.Binding
	Tab2    key.Binding
	Tab3    key.Binding
	Tab4    key.Binding
	Help    key.Binding
	Quit    key.Binding
}

//nolint:unused // used in later task (memories tab implementation)
type memoriesKeys struct {
	Up         key.Binding
	Down       key.Binding
	Enter      key.Binding
	Activate   key.Binding
	Promote    key.Binding
	Suppress   key.Binding
	Unsuppress key.Binding
	Archive    key.Binding
	Prune      key.Binding
	Filter     key.Binding
	Search     key.Binding
	New        key.Binding
	Escape     key.Binding
}

//nolint:unused // used in later task (injection tab implementation)
type injectionKeys struct {
	Up     key.Binding
	Down   key.Binding
	Focus  key.Binding
	Enter  key.Binding
	Escape key.Binding
}

//nolint:unused // used in later task (history tab implementation)
type historyKeys struct {
	Up      key.Binding
	Down    key.Binding
	Refresh key.Binding
}

//nolint:unused // used in later task (settings tab implementation)
type settingsKeys struct {
	Mode    key.Binding
	Policy  key.Binding
	MaxUp   key.Binding
	MaxDown key.Binding
}

var globalKeyMap = globalKeys{
	TabNext: key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("tab"), key.WithHelp("tab", "next tab")),
	TabPrev: key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("shift+tab"), key.WithHelp("shift+tab", "prev tab")),
	Tab1:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("1"), key.WithHelp("1", "memories")),
	Tab2:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("2"), key.WithHelp("2", "injection")),
	Tab3:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("3"), key.WithHelp("3", "history")),
	Tab4:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("4"), key.WithHelp("4", "settings")),
	Help:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("?"), key.WithHelp("?", "help")),
	Quit:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("q", "ctrl+c"), key.WithHelp("q", "quit")),
}

//nolint:unused // used in later task (memories tab implementation)
var memoriesKeyMap = memoriesKeys{
	Up:         key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("up", "k"), key.WithHelp("up/k", "up")),
	Down:       key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("down", "j"), key.WithHelp("down/j", "down")),
	Enter:      key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("enter"), key.WithHelp("enter", "toggle detail")),
	Activate:   key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("a"), key.WithHelp("a", "activate")),
	Promote:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("P"), key.WithHelp("P", "promote")),
	Suppress:   key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("s"), key.WithHelp("s", "suppress")),
	Unsuppress: key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("u"), key.WithHelp("u", "unsuppress")),
	Archive:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("x"), key.WithHelp("x", "archive")),
	Prune:      key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("D"), key.WithHelp("D", "prune")),
	Filter:     key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("f"), key.WithHelp("f", "cycle filter")),
	Search:     key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("/"), key.WithHelp("/", "search")),
	New:        key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("n"), key.WithHelp("n", "new memory")),
	Escape:     key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("esc"), key.WithHelp("esc", "cancel")),
}

//nolint:unused // used in later task (injection tab implementation)
var injectionKeyMap = injectionKeys{
	Up:     key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("up", "k"), key.WithHelp("up/k", "up")),
	Down:   key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("down", "j"), key.WithHelp("down/j", "down")),
	Focus:  key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("i"), key.WithHelp("i", "focus input")),
	Enter:  key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("enter"), key.WithHelp("enter", "test prompt")),
	Escape: key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("esc"), key.WithHelp("esc", "unfocus")),
}

//nolint:unused // used in later task (history tab implementation)
var historyKeyMap = historyKeys{
	Up:      key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("up", "k"), key.WithHelp("up/k", "up")),
	Down:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("down", "j"), key.WithHelp("down/j", "down")),
	Refresh: key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("R"), key.WithHelp("R", "refresh")),
}

//nolint:unused // used in later task (settings tab implementation)
var settingsKeyMap = settingsKeys{
	Mode:    key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("m"), key.WithHelp("m", "cycle mode")),
	Policy:  key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("p"), key.WithHelp("p", "cycle policy")),
	MaxUp:   key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("+", "="), key.WithHelp("+", "increase max")),
	MaxDown: key.NewBinding(key.WithKeys("-"), key.WithHelp("-", "decrease max")),
}

    72→//nolint:ireturn // required by bubbletea Model interface
    73→func (m rootModel) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
    74→	var cmds []tea.Cmd
    75→
    76→	switch msg := msg.(type) {
    77→	case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
    78→		m.width = min(msg.Width, maxWidth)
    79→		m.height = msg.Height
    80→		m.memoriesTab.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
    81→		m.injectionTab.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
    82→		m.historyTab.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
    83→		m.settingsTab.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
    84→		return m, nil
    85→
    86→	case tea.KeyMsg:
    87→		// Global keys -- check before delegating to tabs
    88→		switch {
    89→		case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Quit):
    90→			return m, tea.Quit
    91→		case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Help):
    92→			m.showHelp = !m.showHelp
    93→			return m, nil
    94→		case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.TabNext):
    95→			m.activeTab = (m.activeTab + 1) % 4
    96→			return m, nil
    97→		case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.TabPrev):
    98→			m.activeTab = (m.activeTab + 3) % 4
    99→			return m, nil
   100→		case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Tab1):
   101→			m.activeTab = tabMemories
   102→			return m, nil
   103→		case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Tab2):
   104→			m.activeTab = tabInjection
   105→			return m, nil
   106→		case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Tab3):
   107→			m.activeTab = tabHistory
   108→			return m, nil
   109→		case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Tab4):
   110→			m.activeTab = tabSettings
   111→			return m, nil
   112→		}
   113→
   114→	case stateLoadedMsg:
   115→		if msg.err != nil {
   116→			m.err = msg.err
   117→			return m, nil
   118→		}
   119→		m.state = msg.state
   120→		m.pushState()
   121→		return m, nil
   122→
   123→	case lifecycleActionMsg:
   124→		return m.handleLifecycleAction(msg)
   125→
   126→	case addMemoryMsg:
   127→		return m.handleAddMemory(msg)
   128→
   129→	case pruneMsg:
   130→		return m.handlePrune()
   131→
   132→	case settingsChangedMsg:
   133→		return m.handleSettingsChanged(msg)
   134→
   135→	case testPromptMsg:
   136→		if m.state == nil || m.state.Store == nil {
   137→			return m, nil
   138→		}
   139→		matches := memoryloop.SelectRelevant(*m.state.Store, msg.prompt, time.Now())
   140→		return m, func() tea.Msg { return testPromptResultMsg{matches: matches} }
   141→
   142→	case errorFlashMsg:
   143→		m.errFlash = msg.text
   144→		return m, tea.Tick(2*time.Second, func(time.Time) tea.Msg { return clearErrorMsg{} })
   145→
   146→	case clearErrorMsg:
   147→		m.errFlash = ""
   148→		return m, nil
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	// Delegate to active tab
   152→	var cmd tea.Cmd
   153→	switch m.activeTab {
   154→	case tabMemories:
   155→		m.memoriesTab, cmd = m.memoriesTab.update(msg)
   156→	case tabInjection:
   157→		m.injectionTab, cmd = m.injectionTab.update(msg)
   158→	case tabHistory:
   159→		m.historyTab, cmd = m.historyTab.update(msg)
   160→	case tabSettings:
   161→		m.settingsTab, cmd = m.settingsTab.update(msg)
   162→	}
   163→	if cmd != nil {
   164→		cmds = append(cmds, cmd)
   165→	}
   166→
   167→	return m, tea.Batch(cmds...)
   168→}

   240→func (m rootModel) handleLifecycleAction(msg lifecycleActionMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
   241→	if m.state == nil || m.state.Store == nil || m.isRefreshing {
   242→		return m, nil

   244→	updated, _, err := memoryloop.TransitionRecordLifecycle(m.state.Store.Records, msg.id, msg.action, time.Now())

   246→		return m, func() tea.Msg { return errorFlashMsg{text: err.Error()} }
   247→	}
   248→	m.state.Store.Records = updated
   249→	if err := m.saveState(); err != nil {
   250→		return m, func() tea.Msg { return errorFlashMsg{text: fmt.Sprintf("save failed: %v", err)} }
   251→	}
   252→	m.pushState()
   253→	return m, nil
   254→}

   274→func (m rootModel) handlePrune() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
   275→	if m.state == nil || m.state.Store == nil || m.isRefreshing {

   278→	updated, result := memoryloop.PruneRecords(m.state.Store.Records, time.Now())
